assumptions.rounding_rule: All displayed currency values rounded to nearest $10; rates shown as percentages with up to 2 decimals. Historical source-table values are rounded before display.
assumptions.privacy_rule: No personal names, street addresses, ZIP codes, parcel/APN IDs, account numbers, or exact traceable public-record values in public outputs.

A.label: Property A (Santa Clara County, CA) — inherited by trust
A.role: Inherited property; not currently owned by Owner B before transfer
A.value_note: Planning range around a 2026 estimate; obtain independent date-of-death/appraisal comps before decisions.

B.label: Property B (San Francisco, CA) — already owned
B.role: Already owned by Owner B; primary residence with rental units

path_comparison_base.name: Live in Property A (primary residence)
path_comparison_base.key_risks: Prop 19 eligibility/file deadlines; maintenance/capex shocks; concentration risk; opportunity cost vs. reinvestment
path_comparison_base.tax_notes: If Prop 19 exclusion applies, assessed value may carry over within value cap; primary residence exclusion may apply on later sale if ownership/use tests met. Verify eligibility.

path_comparison_base.name: Rent Property A; live in Property B
path_comparison_base.key_risks: Rent estimate unverified; vacancy; tenant/lease/legal risk; depreciation recapture; property-tax reassessment if Prop 19 not applicable; capex shocks
path_comparison_base.tax_notes: Rental income taxable; depreciation may apply but creates recapture on sale; Prop 19 parent-child exclusion generally not available if not owner-occupied as primary residence. Verify with CPA.

path_comparison_base.name: Sell Property A near transfer; reinvest proceeds
path_comparison_base.key_risks: Market sequence risk; reinvestment risk; tax drag; behavioral risk; loss of real-asset/inflation hedge; transaction costs
path_comparison_base.tax_notes: Step-up in basis may reduce/eliminate capital gain if sold soon after death; state/federal taxes still depend on timing, income, and basis documentation. Price transfer tax/recording fees into net.

path_comparison_base.name: Live in Property A 2 years, then sell and reinvest
path_comparison_base.key_risks: Timing risk; eligibility for primary-residence exclusion depends on ownership/use tests; Prop 19 implications; sequence risk after sale
path_comparison_base.tax_notes: Primary-residence exclusion rules (IRC 121) require meeting ownership and use tests; confirm with CPA. Step-up basis and holding period matter.

path_comparison_base.name: Sell, park proceeds in 3M–2Y Treasuries 24 months, then phase into stocks over 36 months
path_comparison_base.key_risks: Cash drag/reinvestment risk during holding period; inflation erosion; missed upside if markets rise; still exposed to market risk after phasing
path_comparison_base.tax_notes: Treasury interest taxable; capital gains/dividends taxed as realized. Reinvestment and yield changes are material risks.

black_swan_scenarios.name: 1929-style crash analog (illustrative)
black_swan_scenarios.description: Severe equity drawdown early in holding period, slow recovery, deflationary shock then policy response. Used to stress sequence-of-returns risk for sell-and-reinvest path.
black_swan_scenarios.notes: Illustrative stress scenario only; not a forecast. Sequence risk is highest when large lump sum enters near peak.

black_swan_scenarios.name: 2008-style financial crisis analog (illustrative)
black_swan_scenarios.description: Sharp equity decline, credit stress, housing weakness, then recovery supported by policy.
black_swan_scenarios.notes: Illustrative stress scenario only; highlights drawdown + recovery and housing/equity correlation risk.

black_swan_scenarios.name: 1970s-style stagflation analog (illustrative)
black_swan_scenarios.description: High inflation, weak real returns, rising rates, uneven equity performance.
black_swan_scenarios.notes: Illustrative stress scenario only; real (inflation-adjusted) outcomes can be much worse than nominal.

deadlines.date_or_window: Date of death / trust transfer event
deadlines.item: Obtain written date-of-death valuation for Property A
deadlines.why: Establishes fair market value for basis and reporting; supports step-up basis documentation.

deadlines.item: If claiming parent-child exclusion, transferee must occupy Property A as primary residence and file homeowner's/disabled veteran's exemption
deadlines.why: Prop 19 requires primary-residence occupancy and timely exemption filing for exclusion.

deadlines.date_or_window: Within 3 years of transfer, or before transfer to 3rd party (earlier)
deadlines.item: File Prop 19 claim form (BOE-19-P/BOE-19-G as applicable)
deadlines.why: Required to claim intergenerational transfer exclusion; late filing may limit relief.

deadlines.date_or_window: 9 months after death (plus extensions if applicable)
deadlines.item: Federal estate tax return (Form 706) if required or if portability election desired
deadlines.why: Required when gross estate exceeds filing threshold; portability election must be timely made on complete Form 706.

deadlines.date_or_window: Same tax year as inheritance (if considering sale)
deadlines.why: Timing affects gain, basis documentation, CA taxable income, and 1% Behavioral Health Services Tax (formerly Mental Health Services Tax) exposure above $1M.

deadlines.item: Price transfer tax, recording fees, broker/closing costs, and repairs
deadlines.why: Net proceeds can differ materially from gross sale price.

deadlines.item: Write investment policy statement (IPS) for sale proceeds
deadlines.why: Prevents ad hoc allocation and manages sequence/reinvestment risk.

deadlines.item: Re-run model with updated valuations, tax law, insurance, rents, and spending
deadlines.why: Assumptions drift; laws change; decisions should be refreshed.
